champion.tips: HECARIM TIPS AND TRICKS Do not sit on your Ultimate R for too long. Whenever it’s up, try to gank a lane as it is a great tool that will help you with getting kills and taking over the map. Hecarim is a strong early game duelist. When playing against weak enemies, invade their jungle and try to fight them early on and force them out of their jungle. Team fights are going to be difficult for you as you’re prone to poke. Using your Ultimate R , try and flank the enemy from an unwarded bush or from the side so the enemy cannot poke you down and force you to disengage.
champion.builds: THE BEST HECARIM BUILDS, RUNES AND ITEMS FOR JUNGLE IN EMERALD + Most Popular If you want to use the most popular Hecarim Jungle build, you should take Ghost and Smite as your Summoner Spells. For runes, you should pick Phase Rush as your keystone, followed by Nimbus Cloak, Celerity and Waterwalking in the primary tree, as well as Legend: Haste and Triumph in the secondary tree. For rune shards, you want Adaptive Force in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health Scaling in defense, though it depends on the matchup. Finally, for your items, you should build Spear of Shojin as your first item, followed by Ionian Boots of Lucidity and Black Cleaver. For your last 3 items, you should build Death's Dance, Maw of Malmortius and finish with Eclipse. For the skill order, you want to stick with Q - W - E. Right now, this build has 51.6% winrate over 9 475 matches played. Alternative If you're looking for alternatives, you can use Ghost and Smite as your Summoner Spells, with runes being Conqueror as your keystone, Triumph, Legend: Haste and Last Stand in the primary tree, and Celerity with Nimbus Cloak in the secondary tree, as well as Attack Speed, Adaptive Force, and Health Scaling as your rune shards. The items that this build incorporates are Spear of Shojin as your first item, then Ionian Boots of Lucidity as a second item and Black Cleaver as a third item. You want to finish the build with Death's Dance, Maw of Malmortius and Guardian Angel. As far as ability max order goes, you want to keep it Q - W - E. This build is currently sitting at a 50.2% win rate across 2 185 matches played. Off-Meta If you want to try an Off-Meta Hecarim Jungle build in the current patch, try Ghost and Smite as your Summoner Spells, Phase Rush, Nimbus Cloak, Celerity and Waterwalking as your primary rune tree, and Legend: Haste with Triumph as your secondary tree. Use Adaptive Force, Adaptive Force and Health Scaling as your shards. For items in this build, you want to complete Youmuu's Ghostblade as your first item, then finish Ionian Boots of Lucidity as your second item, and Spear of Shojin as third item. The last 3 options are Serylda's Grudge, Death's Dance and Maw of Malmortius. The ability order for this build is Q - W - E. As of the current patch, this build has a 49.5% win rate over 568 matches played. Situational Hecarim Runes and Items Depending on the context of your game, your matchup, and enemy champions, you might want to consider building some situational items or take specific runes. Carefully examine your team, enemy team, game state , and your matchup to plan your Hecarim build accordingly! For example, when it comes to rune shards, you might want to take either Armor or Magic Resist, depending on which champion you are about to lane against. Furthermore, if you want a more detailed breakdown, you should also check out Hecarim runes page.
